label: late copy steps of length-9 sequences (sparse, unpredictable)
explanation: Very sparse reset-gate unit (~0.03% of steps). Fires only in the copy phase, almost entirely on length-9 sequences (96% of mass; a little on L=8), concentrated on the last two copy steps (t=16,17; ~70% of mass) with a secondary bump around recall_idx 3-4. Never fires in the original or delimiter phase, or on L<=7. Inputs m (15x lift), k, t, d, e, r are over-represented, and outputs h/i/m slightly, but no token or position conjunction gets precision above ~10%: the context predicate covers 62% of actives / 71% of mass at <1% precision. Magnitude is largest at the final copy step; what selects the specific firing sequences was not found.
